name: TestScriptCategoryGroup
title: TestScript category groups
description: Fixed set of `group` codes used by the `https://haste.health/fhir/StructureDefinition/testscript-category` extension on TestScript operation/assert elements in backend/testscripts/core/*.testscript.json. A website reading these TestScripts plus their TestReports can group assertions by these codes to show 'what does the server support' without parsing labels or query strings.
